export GALAXY_URL="https://usegalaxy.org"

# Create a new history

  -H "x-api-key: ${GALAXY_API_KEY}" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"name": "RCV Mann-Whitney Analysis - Animal vs Fungal Orthologs"}')
echo "Create response: $CREATE_RESP"
NEW_HISTORY_ID=$(echo "$CREATE_RESP" | python3 -c "import sys,json; print(json.load(sys.stdin)['id'])")
echo "New history ID: $NEW_HISTORY_ID"
